articleTitle: Point Cloud Splicing Based on 3D-Harris Operator
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: The paper proposes an algorithm of point cloud splicing based on 3D-Harris operator. First, it extracts 3D interest points efficiently according to the combination of 3D-Harris operator and normal vector. Then it calculates the fast point feature histogram (FPFH) of all 3D interest points, as a result of which the initial transformation matrix is calculated through FPFH. Last, ICP algorithm is used to realize the accurate registration. At the last part, experiment shows that the method has high efficiency in point cloud splicing and performs well in scenes with more corners.

articleTitle: Human Identification Based on mmWave Radar Using Deep Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: With the development of computer vision technology, camera-based face recognition technology provides convenience in many aspects. However, large-scale application of face recognition has brought up privacy concern. Compared with the camera, millimeter-wave radar for identification is a more secure device due to its no concern in t privacy leakage. In this paper, millimeter-wave radar is employed to collect Range-Doppler heat map data in five experimenters of people walking. Classic deep CNN models such as AlexNet, VGGNet, GoogLeNet, and ResNet are used to extract features from the heat maps. The features are extracted by the models and the feature vector is subsequently sent to the classifier for identity recognition. It is demonstrated that that it is feasible to use the deep CNN model and Range-Doppler heat map for identity recognition. The test accuracy of all models is over 96% and the ResNet model has the highest accuracy of 97.9%.

articleTitle: Fast Reconstruction and Optimization of 3D Temperature Field Based-on Kriging Interpolation
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: With the widespread application of the Internet of Things technology in the industrial field, the research on 3D temperature field reconstruction technology has also received widespread attention. A fast reconstruction algorithm of 3D temperature field based on Kriging interpolation is proposed. Through CFD software simulation, the three-dimensional space simulation temperature field and the temperature data of the sensor node are obtained. According to the spatial position and temperature information about the sensor node, the Kriging interpolation method is used to realize the rapid reconstruction of the three-dimensional temperature field. In order to improve the overall accuracy of the reconstructed temperature field, an improved genetic algorithm is used to optimize the parameters of the Kriging interpolation method. The results show that the three-dimensional temperature field can be quickly reconstructed based on the Kriging interpolation method, and the optimized reconstructed temperature field can accurately reflect the temperature change trend.

articleTitle: Emotion Classification from Short-term EEG Signals in Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: Emotion is the result of brain processing after the combination of the surrounding environmental state and the individual physiological state. Its essence is the individual perceptual response to the things around him, and the result of the interaction between man and the environment. There is a strong correlation between human cognitive behavior and psychological activities and EEG signals. The physiological activities of the brain can directly reflect individual emotional activities. EEG signal is one of the important input signals in the affective calculation. Correct emotion representation is a key step in emotion recognition research. This paper aims to study emotion EEG recognition through the representation of emotion classification. The author collected 4000 EEG samples (including 64 channels) of four emotions with a time length of 3s, which were neutral, happy, sad, and fear. According to the characteristic that emotions can not be mutated, setting the sample length of 3s can more flexibly grasp the subjects' emotions in a short time. In this paper, two deep learning methods, LSTM and CNN, are used to identify the positive and negative emotions of the new dataset and DEAP (Database for Emotion Analysis using Physical Signal, including 40 channels). The accuracy of the new dataset is 89% and 74% respectively, which are higher than 72% and 70% of DEAP.

articleTitle: Analysis of Carbon Emission Status in Building Sector of One Province in China
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: The paper calculates and analyzes the current situation of carbon emission from building sector in one province in China. The research shows that carbon emissions from building sector in this province mainly come from public buildings and residential buildings, accounting for 43.56% and 46.84% of the total carbon emissions, respectively. GDP growth and improvement of people's lives have a significant role in promoting carbon emissions in the building sector. According to the existing development model, it is difficult for the building sector of this province to achieve peak carbon emissions in 2030. Therefore, it is necessary to carry out carbon reduction measures in the construction sector based on the actual conditions of this province.

articleTitle: A General Cloud Service Architecture of Smart City Based on Component Assembling
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: In the information age, managers urgently need to improve their ability to manage cities comprehensively, so building a smart city has become an unstoppable trend. In this process, the cross-industry business collaboration at the municipal level is the difficulty and focus of construction. This paper puts forward the concept of a component-based cloud service architecture for the smart city. It focuses on business reuse and collaboration relationship sorting. It maps the municipal cross-industry business collaboration into the organic combination of several basic concepts such as component, service, and cloud. Because of its loose coupling and flexible application characteristics, the component-based cloud service architecture for the smart city will become one of the common essential capability platforms of the smart city.

articleTitle: A Novel Car-following Model by Considering Driver's Behaviors with Fuzzy Inference Method
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: The traditional traffic flow modeling lacks a reasonable analysis of the driver's psychological expectation. Combined with fuzzy inference, this paper constructs a car following model to adapt to the driver's psychological expectation and safety driving braking strategy. The empirical intuition method is adopted to divide the input and output variables into fuzzy interval through the triangular membership function. Then the inference rules of the divided fuzzy interval is carried out through Mamdani model. After the fuzzy rules are obtained. The center of gravity method is used to defuzzify the fuzzy system. Finally, the security of the defuzzification results is analyzed. The simulation results show that the model is safe and available in driving scenarios.

articleTitle: DXICP: A Fast Registration Algorithm for Point Cloud
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: The registration of point cloud is essentially to obtain a relatively accurate coordinate transformation matrix through operation. Generally speaking, the registration is to discover the position conversion matrix of the overlap between clouds. In this paper, a new algorithm DXICP is raised to handle the problem of low precision and slow time of traditional ICP. First, uniform downsampling is carried out after the input of the original point cloud. Then the 3D-SIFT algorithm is used to extract the feature points, and the FPFH algorithm is used to describe that. Finally, the RANSAC algorithm is used for rough registration, and then the optimized ICP is used for precise registration. The algorithm in this paper is proved to be better than the traditional ICP in both accuracy and speed.

articleTitle: A Police Resource Optimization System Based on Intelligence Research, Judgment and Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: The social contradiction is becoming complex, and the workload of police officers is also growing while there is no significant increase in the number of police officers. The efficient optimization on the allocation of police resources has become an urgent issue for public security organs. Big data technology provides a new method for the optimization of police resources. This paper designed a potential criminal prediction and police resource optimization system based on existing allocation of police resources in the jurisdiction. Based on the data analysis of police work, case information, and public security organs, the system will predict the key locations where potential criminals exist, so as to provide scientific and optimized allocation strategies of police resources, effectively improve the police's response capability.

articleTitle: Research on Climate Prediction Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: Based on the data of solar radiation and ocean temperature, a climate prediction model is established by using BP neural network. Firstly, the neural network model is trained by using the climate element data of the past 1979–2018, the input of BP neural network is solar long wave, short wave radiation, temperature at 2m height and sea level temperature, and the output is the temperature at 2m height on the ground, the trained neural network model is used to predict the summer temperature change in the next 25 years. The results show that the predicted value obtained by the model is very close to the real value, and the prediction error obtained by the model fluctuates around 0. It is expected that the temperature in summer 2043 will increase by 0.2-0.3 °C compared with that in 2018.

articleTitle: Application of BIM and GIS in Emergency Management of Smart Cities
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: As the BIM technology is broadly used and speedily developed, we are constantly moving towards a smart city, integrating mature GIS technology, and moving towards a broad road to a smart city. In this paper, the integration of BIM technology and GIS technology is realized based on the IFC standard and the Supermap platform, and then a smart system for urban emergency management is formed to combine the Internet and the Internet of Things. This system highly responds to the call of building a “smart city”, which provides a feasible scheme for improving the level of urban emergency management.

articleTitle: Short Text Classification via Hypergraph Convolution Network
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: Effective classification of short texts is a key task in many areas, such as web search, literature recommendation and emotion analysis and so on. It can effectively help users find relevant information. With the increasing number of short texts, how to classify short texts with short content and sparse features has become a popular research theme in recent years. We propose a short text classification method via hypergraph convolution network, which can flexibly capture the complex high-order relationships of words in the short text. Specifically, firstly, the method models an individual text as hyperedges, so that all words are connected with each other. Different hyperedges are connected by shared words and form a hypergraph containing high-order correlation. Secondly, a hypergraph convolution network is performed to learn the feature representation of words and short text. Finally, the classification model is used to achieve short text classification. The results of the experiments suggest that this method can successfully classify short texts. Further experimental analysis verifies the importance of using hypergraph to model short text to alleviate the problems of sparse data and limited labeled data, and proves the rationality and effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: Research on Product Kansei Intention Model based on BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: Facing the design and development of complex products, the traditional design innovation model can not solve the problem of the transformation of consumers' emotional information in the design process. The main reason is that users' emotional information is difficult to capture in the design process, and the traditional design process can not solve complex problems. In this case, it is necessary to establish a product perceptual intention model based on perceptual engineering and neural network. The model is not only a new method of product innovation design, but also a market-oriented process to reduce design risk. This research is an interdisciplinary application research. Taking the electric water heater product as an example, the model is constructed, mainly using the relevant theoretical knowledge of perceptual engineering and neural network. The model transforms emotional information into measurable data, and establishes the corresponding relationship between product shape structure and perceptual evaluation value through BP neural network. The model provides a reliable scientific theoretical basis for the perceptual design of products, can speed up the product development process, reduce the development cost, and make the development results more in line with consumers' expectations. The model is suitable for enterprise application and is an effective supplement to the traditional design method. Similarly, the model can also provide reference for the development and design of other products.

articleTitle: A Study on Data-Driven Product Innovation Model
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: This paper studies the basic theories of data-driven product innovation and design. In the context of the era of big data, based on the analysis of the concept and development of product data, a model of data-driven product design is derived. By comparing traditional design methods with those in the data age. This paper presents the process and mode of data-driven design and the method of data processing. In the analysis of the actual case, use Python language programming and use this language code to expand the network to crawl data, and use the obtained data samples to train the model.

articleTitle: The Sensorless Nursing System Based on 5G Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: This paper introduces a sensorless nursing system based on 5G Internet of Things (5G-IoT), which consists of 5G-IoT intelligent terminals (LED bulb, smart socket) and intelligent care platform system. Intelligent terminal automatically reads the on-off lamp data and the motion information measured by the millimeter wave radar. Then the intelligent terminal uses 5G-IoT system to send the living and physical data of the elderly to the platform in time, and the platform uses AI algorithm to automatically warn the health problems of the elderly, then the relevant information is sent to the guardian or community management department by mobile information means such as Wechat applet, APP, SMS, etc. to achieve 24-hour continuous senseless nursing.

articleTitle: A Scalable Indoor 3D Reconstruction Method Based on RGB-D
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: This research develops an advanced two-phase pose estimate solution that efficiently addresses 3D reconstruction on large scenes. Unlike existing parallel pose-estimate approaches, our scheme better trade-offs memory consumption and accuracy. In the first stage, we perform a segmentation operation on the input sequence, with intra-block reference frame selection, pose map generation and pose map optimization to obtain the relative pose for each frame. In the second stage, we perform inter-block processing to convert all poses into one world coordinate system by global pose optimization. In particular, we only perform mesh reconstruction and point cloud alignment for the reference chunks in the global optimization phase, which greatly reduces computational resources. In addition, to improve the scalability and robustness of the system, we introduce advanced deep learning schemes to accomplish feature point extraction and matching for different frames. Our experimental results show that the proposed parallel pose estimation solution is feasible in large-scale scene reconstruction.

articleTitle: Discussion on Calculation Method of Equivalent Area of Building Lightning Strike
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: At present, the calculation method in Appendix a of Code for Lightning Protection Design of Buildings GB50057-2010 is the calculation method of lightning equivalent area regular buildings, so it is very complicated and difficult to calculate the equivalent area of buildings with irregular shape or unequal height. In this paper, based on the research on the calculation method of lightning equivalent area in the Code for Lightning Protection Design of Buildings GB 50057–2010 in the calculation of equivalent area of buildings, the calculation model is established by using computer CAD engineering drawing software, and reasonable suggestions are put forward according to the engineering practice of different buildings. Besides, a set of methods for calculating equivalent area of lightning strike is formed, which has certain practical significance for calculating the estimated number of lightning strikes and the lightning risk value.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Management of Enterprise Science and Technology Investment Core Elements Based on BP Neural Network Model-Taking the scientific and technological investment of UAV aerial survey technology as an example
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: This paper is to study the core element analysis and management method of enterprise science and technology investment, taking UAV aerial survey technology investment as an example, by analyzing the application of UAV, an index system including 16 indexes is established from four main aspects of equipment, personnel, software and capital, and a BP neural network model with the function of automatic feedback and correction is used to evaluate the effect. The conclusion of the model evaluation results proves that the method can be used to evaluate the development of the invested enterprises quantitatively, so as to identify the investment effect of UAV aerial survey technology application. The investment effect evaluation of UAV aerial survey technology application described in this paper can provide objective guidance for the investment content and direction of UAV technology application, and has certain research significance and application prospect.

articleTitle: Self-training Two-Stage 3D Object Detection With Noisy Student
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: As the core technology of autonomous driving, 3D object detection has attracted a great interest of lots of researchers. Many 3D object detection methods achieved promising performance. However, current 3D object detection method relies heavily on 3D annotation. The quantity and quality of annotation directly determine the performance of current 3D object detector, but 3D annotation is very expensive and require lots of human labor. Based upon the predicament described above, we proposed ST-PointRCNN: a semi-supervised 3D object detection method in autonomous driving, and achieves good results. Specifically, we apply student-teacher framework to train and improve the accuracy of the student model. We filter the predictions of teacher model and only keep high confidence predictions as pseudo labels. To expand the unlabeled data set and make the pseudo labels relatively more accurate than the predictions of student model, we design consistency losses for two-stage 3D object detection method to improve the robustness of the detector to data noise. Finally, we also conduct extensive experiments on KITTI dataset. The results show that comparing to the supervised method our method improve the average of car, pedestrian, and cyclist for easy difficulty by 8.8%, 9.4% and 7.1 % respectively when using 5% of label data.

articleTitle: Exploring Neighborhood Service and Development Strategies by Multi-dimensional Sentiment Analysis of Online Restaurant Review
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: With the rise of the Internet economy, cyber data have interacted with the physical world. One of the directions is to merge attribute and qualitative data with location information. In this paper, we apply the sentiment analysis of online restaurant reviews based on the public data from Meituan and Weibo, the two most influential online platforms in China, to study the restaurant facility in the neighborhood from the perspective of users, and look for neighborhood services' management and development strategies in the big data background. This paper takes Shanghai as an example, establishing a multi-dimensional evaluation model to study Shanghai's restaurant facilities from seven dimensions, which are obtained and categorized from a bottom-up method. Different from the “quantity” analysis in previous studies of neighborhood facilities, this paper pays more attention to the “quality” analysis of neighborhood facilities from the perspective of residents. Besides, this paper also enriches the empirical study of bidirectional LSTM sentiment analysis, which will promote the development of restaurant business and neighborhood services, and contribute to both the economic benefits of enterprises and refined governance of cities.

articleTitle: Deep User Interest Mining Network Based on Attention Mechanism and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: Click-through rate prediction plays an important role in recommendation systems and online advertising. Most CTR prediction models focus more on innovative research on feature interaction, but ignore the mining and application of user behavior sequences. There are many shortcomings and shortcomings in the in-depth mining of user interests, especially in the use of the user's historical behavior sequence characteristics, which can still be optimized and improved. In this article, we propose a new model: User Interest Mining Network (UIMN). This model innovatively designs the User Behavior Interest Network (UBIN), which is used to deeply mine user interests, and at the same time innovatively introduce User-Item Relational Network (UIRN). The model processed the user's behavior sequence in long and short term, and considered the influence of the target item on the sequence, and finally got the updated behavior sequence. In addition, the model introduces the relationship between users and target item, and combines DNN and LSTM networks to improve the accuracy of estimation. UIMN con-ducted experiments on Amazon commodity dataset and MovieLens dataset, and the AUC value of the model increased by 1.6% to 2.4% compared with the benchmark model, which proved the effectiveness of the model.

articleTitle: An Study on Clustering Algorithm-Driven Product Innovation
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: This paper uses data mining technology to obtain data required for product innovation design, obtains word cloud information required for product design innovation through data clustering analysis, and drives product innovation based on information clustered by big data. In the big data environment, the core problem of K-means clustering data-driven product innovation is based on Python programming, the model is trained based on the acquired data, and the product innovation model is driven by the constructed K-means clustering algorithm.

articleTitle: A Low-cost Full-spectrum Water Quality Real-time Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: This article focuses on a real-time water quality monitoring system based on ultraviolet-visible spectroscopy. The system is equipped with a self-cleaning system to ensure the robustness of long-term use and measurement. The system adopts multi-sensor information fusion technology, which can simultaneously realize multi-parameter measurement of Chemical Oxygen Demand (COD), NO<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3-</sup> and turbidity, and can carry out remote data transmission through wireless network to realize intelligent real-time assessment and early warning of water quality. Focus on establishing a full-spectrum inversion model for the three pollution factors of COD, nitrate nitrogen and turbidity, and use partial least squares (PLS) to establish the model. Finally, the linear correlation coefficient between the predicted value of COD and the actual value can reach more than 0.99. The NO<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3-</sup> concentration and turbidity can reach above 0.999.

articleTitle: Construction Path of Smart Medical System for the Aged in Community Based on Internet
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: As the accelerated population aging is an important risk and challenge for the current development, it is a social problem that needs to be solved urgently to innovate the community pension model to cope with population aging. In this paper, starting from the background of the current smart old-age policy and based on the level of community medical care, the importance of embedding the community old-age care system through the Internet is put forward, and how to establish the smart medical care system for the community old-age care is discussed. Based on case study of the practice of Nanjing Health Eldercare Service Center, a cloud platform of “Internet+ Medical Community Health” is proposed, the wearable functional terminal equipment is developed, and some countermeasures and suggestions such as designing an early warning system are put forward.

articleTitle: A Method of Dynamic Traffic Scene Reconstruction Based on Roadside Lidar
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: The restoration of dynamic traffic scenes is of great practical significance, especially for the reproduction and analysis of the accident scene. At present, 3D reconstruction methods can only be used for static scene reconstruction, and their real-time performance is poor. We try to restore the real traffic scene by combining Oblique photography, 3D target detection, and multi-view 3D reconstruction methods and use BEV map to generate video from the overlooking perspective, which can help the relevant staff to analyze the traffic scene in an all-round way. We do experiments on vehicle lidar and roadside lidar data, and the experimental results show that our framework can be well applied to these two scenarios. We can accurately locate the people and cars on the scene and restore the situation at that time.

articleTitle: Learning Attention Augmented Spatial-temporal Normality for Video Anomaly Detection
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: Video anomaly detection is an essential and challenging task in the computer vision community, which aims to automatically detect and localize abnormal events in videos. In this paper, we propose an attention augmented spatial-temporal normality learning framework to explore the unique spatial and temporal patterns of normal events. Specifically, we first slice the videos into local spatial-temporal cubes along the spatial and temporal dimensions to facilitate independent learning of the prototypical spatial and temporal patterns of normal videos. In the training phase, we use parallel deep convolutional neural networks to learn the spatial features of each cube and introduce an attention module to guide the model to focus on the important local cubes. Then, to exploit the complementary information of adjacent video fragments in the temporal dimension, we use a convolutional long-short memory network to model temporal patterns. In the testing phase, we calculate the prediction errors of the salient areas and compute the anomaly score by measuring the difference between the testing samples and the learned spatial-temporal normality. Experimental results on standard benchmarks show that the proposed method achieves a comparable performance to the state-of-the-art methods with frame-level AUCs of 96.6%, 85.2%, and 68.8% on UCSD Ped2, CUHK Avenue, and ShanghaiTech, respectively.

articleTitle: Intelligent Parking lot Assistance System Based on Machine Vision and A⁎ Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: Today's society, the term “artificial intelligence” has become one of the hot topics in the field of scientific and technological development and innovation. Its technical products have been put into the transportation industry, and the operation efficiency of all aspects of transportation has been continuously improved. Intelligent parking lots Car assistance is the performance of intelligence among them. The digital and intelligent development of cities has made the number of vehicles increasing day by day. The parking problem has become a major problem of concern to all countries. The current traditional parking space selection method is too inefficient, prolonging the travel time, and seriously undermining the user's travel experience. Therefore, this article is in wisdom. The pole is equipped with an industrial camera, uses machine vision and A ⁎ algorithm to realize vision-based parking space detection, and proposes a proposed plan for vehicle parking and driving paths. On MATLAB software, a parking assist system for smart parking lots is designed.

articleTitle: Evaluation and Optimization of Smart Rural Logistics System in Zhengzhou City under the Concept of Smart City
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: The concept of smart city emphasizes to solve various contradictions in the development of modern city, involving politics, economy, infrastructure, resources, life and transportation, while smart countryside is not only a support for the development but also an extension of smart city. Logistics, as a basic industry for urban and rural development, is crucial to the construction of both cities and villages. In this paper, under the concept of smart city, the entropy weight fuzzy matter-element theory was used to compare Zhengzhou with Luoyang, Wuhan and Hangzhou, to effectively and objectively evaluate the level of smart rural logistics in Zhengzhou, and specific and feasible optimization suggestions were given from four aspects of infrastructure construction, construction of operation subject, digital logistics information platform and operation supervision mode, in order to promote the construction of smart countryside and even smart city in Zhengzhou city.

articleTitle: A Survey of Recent Advances in Driving Behavior Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: Understanding driving behavior has never been more important to intelligent transportation. It has a significant impact on the advancement of safe and sociable autonomous vehicles. With the advent of smartphones and intelligent connected vehicles, portable data acquisition and efficient driving data processing are enabled, providing unprecedented potential for comprehensive driving behavior analysis (DBA). This research benefits many industries, such as vehicle energy management, autonomous driving systems, advanced driver assistance systems, intelligent traffic systems, and environmental protection. In this study, we conduct a comprehensive literature investigation of the dataset and DBA model. The dataset is reviewed based on available datasets, and we also outline the evaluation metrics of the DBA model. We provide an overview of the DBA model separately, briefly discuss five DBA tasks, and focus on reviewing the smartphone-based DBA model. In addition, we analyze the key research challenges and prospects for future work, hoping to provide guidelines for related researchers.

articleTitle: Segmentation of 3D Point Clouds Based on Boundary Refined Supervoxel
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: This Point cloud segmentation is a fundamental yet challenging step in point cloud processing, with wide applications in object recognition, 3D reconstruction and scene understanding. However, the traditional point cloud segmentation methods are susceptible to data noise and suffer from low segmentation accuracy and blurred boundaries. To this end, we propose a supervoxel-based object segmentation method which consists of three stages. First, a boundary-refined supervoxel segmentation method is proposed to generate the supervoxels as the processing elements, which can guarantee the accuracy of object segmentation boundaries and improve processing efficiency. Second, an improved region growing method is proposed to obtain a series of facets using a novel seed selection criterion. Finally, a convexity-based merging method is proposed to achieve complete objects by judging the concavity between adjacent facets. The method is experimented on synthetic datasets and public datasets. The visualization and quantitative comparison results show that our method outperforms the reference methods in terms of segmentation accuracy and completeness.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Model for Multi-Step Prediction of Building Energy Load Based on EWT Extraction and LSTM
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: Accurate building energy load multi-step prediction facilitates building energy efficiency and management. Time series analysis is often used to deal with the forecasting problem, and the commonly used forecasting algorithm is the Long Short Term Memory (LSTM) algorithm. As building energy consumption data is generally seasonal, uncertain and non-linear, it is difficult to achieve high accuracy with a single algorithmic model. In this paper, the empirical wavelet transform (EWT) method is used to extract the eigenmode functions (IMFs) from the data to overcome the seasonality and non-linearity of the data. However, the EWT approach suffers from the problem of edge effects and the obtained IMFs components have boundary errors at the end, which arise due to the definition of EWT. In this paper, a hybrid model is designed to correct for the boundary error in the EWT decomposition, and the results show that the modal components obtained from the improved empirical wavelet transform are more suitable as input data for the prediction model. Based on the building operation data obtained from real measurements, accurate prediction results can be obtained and can be used as a reference for related prediction studies.

articleTitle: Feature Selection Based on Semantic Information in Complex Indoor Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: The construction of 3D indoor models is of great significance and is applied to indoor services such as AR, VR, 3D printing, and virtual fitting. In the visual community, there is a large drift in image-based pose estimation, which becomes one of the main factors affecting the accuracy of 3D reconstruction. Feature selection plays an essential role in pose estimation. We aim to select better features in a complex indoor environment, and obtain an accurate, robust, and efficient visual odometer to estimate the pose. This paper integrates semantic information into feature extraction, combined with geometric methods. We provide a scoring framework to filter the features of non-information areas and highlight visual saliency features. Weaken the selection of features in non-information areas such as walls, ceilings, and floors, and strengthen feature selection in areas with more information such as special colors, sizes, and shapes. We use fewer points to obtain a more efficient and robust visual odometer by fusing semantic information. We evaluated our methods on the TUM dataset, and the results showed that our algorithm could extract more efficient matching in complex indoor scenes.

articleTitle: A Novel Energy-Saving Control Strategy for Air-Conditioning Water System
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: The energy consumption of air conditioning system accounts for a large part of building energy, and the optimal control strategy plays a vital role in system energy saving. Taking a cooling system of a company in Shanghai as an example, the verification model is established on the TRNSYS-MATLAB co-simulation platform based on the energy data collected by intelligent sensors. A time-division optimization strategy for integrated load forecasting control and indoor temperature fuzzy control is proposed. Finally, the total energy consumption of the system under this strategy is compared by the other two control strategies, namely, the water supply temperature (SWT) control strategy and the all-day room temperature fuzzy (RTF) strategy. Result shows that under the load forecasting integrated (LFI) strategy, the cooling system can save 16.44 % energy without sacrificing thermal comfort.

Author Keywords: Bidirectional Long Short-term Memory neural networks

articleTitle: Commercial Application of XR and Digital Twin Technology in Smart City
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: This article describes the XR and digital twin technologies involved in the construction and development of smart cities, analyzes the application path of XR and digital twin technologies in smart cities, and discusses the commercial application value of XR and digital twin technologies in smart cities.

articleTitle: The Network Ecological Governance Model in Smart City
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: The emphasis of Smart City is laid on the application of information technology, featuring by prominent intelligence, digitization and networking with its multiple-domain social governance model, which enhancing not only the efficiency of urban planning, establishment and management but also the productivity, benefit and level of sustainable development. However, the data interaction and sharing of Smart City generate risk of information disclosure while the technological chasms among different fields and the inherent hysteresis nature may usher in polarized technological problems in governance inevitably. In creating enormous business value and technology welfare, modern science and technology also render new epoch challenges to cyberspace governance. The multi patterns of the rule of law in cyberspace should abide by the thought of preventability, which not only requires the construction of complete cyber supervision system, but also the exertion of the cyber auto-supervision as well as the establishment and perfection of normalized surveillance mechanism. From the aspect of the criminal legislation framework of cybercrimes and in the combination of the law of cyberspace development, it is necessary to pay attention to the coordination and balance of strategies and policies and both the improvement of the governance consciousness and the technological level of cybercrime governance and the avoidance of legislative yaw and the immersion in judicial mistakes should be taken into account. Meanwhile, it is feasible to explore the formulation and deliberation of the international rule of cyberspace governance under the frame of the United Nations in the future.

articleTitle: Research on the Location and Path Optimization of Joint Distribution of Fresh Food Cold-Chain Logistics in the Context of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: At present, consumers' demand for cold-chain logistics becomes more time-sensitive and more personalized. With the application of big data technology, logistics distribution has changed from passive response to forward response through scientific prediction and monitoring. Considering the problems such as low resource integration and broken chain in China's fresh cold-chain distribution, this paper takes Wuming fertile orange as an example, puts forward the common distribution mode of fresh cold-chain logistics, and uses SPSS cluster analysis to determine the distribution center. The mathematical model is established and the optimal distribution path is obtained with the help of Lingo software. After using big data to accurately identify and predict consumer demand, the timeliness of cold-chain logistics distribution is effectively improved and the cost of cold-chain logistics distribution is reduced. At the same time, the cooperation among enterprises is promoted and the utilization rate of cold-chain resources is improved. This study provides some references for cold-chain logistics distribution.

articleTitle: Object Geometric Primitives Detection from 3D Point Clouds Based on the Profiles on Cutting Planes
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: Common man made objects can be represented or composed by some geometric primitives, such as planes, cylinders, spheres, cones, etc. Existing methods reconstruct the geometric primitives by fitting the object with whole point clouds, and these methods need to set the types of model in advance. In this paper, a geometric primitives modeling method based on cutting-plane is proposed for dense 3D point clouds without setting model type in advance. Our method assumes that the original object point clouds have been segmented. First, we cut repeatedly point clouds along the z-axis with a cutting plane, which is parallel to the XOY plane with a step. In this paper, the line of sight is set as Z-axis, because sufficient contours information can be obtained in such cutting direction. The contours may contain both straight lines and quadric curves, so we use clustering to separate lines and curves. After repetitive cutting, each curve cluster has many same-type curves. Then we can recognize the type and estimate the parameters of the point clouds by calculating the curves changing relationship of curves clustering. Last we evaluated our algorithm using synthetic data and real data, and the result shows that our proposed algorithm is efficient and robust.
